title: Restriction-compatible dehomogenization of affine projective presentations
statement: For every scheme S, module F and presentation P [def-amb-vector-projective-presentation-data], t is homogeneous of degree one and the affine section symmetric algebras Sym(F(V)) have dehomogenization equivalences a_V to the degree-zero localizations of P(V) at t. They send generators to x(m)/t and fix coefficients. Their Spec maps followed by the standard Proj chart and relative-Proj embedding commute with all inclusions of affine opens. No local freeness or Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tags 01OA, 01OB, 01OE and 01NG; projective bundles and their standard affine charts

proof.text: Rewrite the presented grading as powers of range(e ∘ ι), and apply the symmetric-algebra dehomogenization theorem on every affine open. This supplies the generator formula and coefficient equality.

proof.text: The prescribed restriction of the presentation carries t to t and x(m) to x(res(m)). Construct the homogeneous localization restriction map and check it on fractions with denominator t^n. The dehomogenization square commutes on scalars and generators and hence by symmetric algebra induction. Conjugate by the equivalences, apply Proj.awayι_comp_map, and then the relative-Proj cocone equation to obtain the scheme chart equality.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affineDehomogenization (S : Scheme.{u}) (F : S.Modules) (P : Presentation S F) : ∃ (ht : ∀ V : S.affineOpens, t P V ∈ P.algebra.grading V 1) (a : ∀ V : S.affineOpens, SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.sections F (op V.1) ≃+* HomogeneousLocalization.Away (P.algebra.grading V) (t P V)), (∀ (V : S.affineOpens) (m : F.val.obj (op V.1)), (a V (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m)).val = algebraMap (P.algebra.obj V) (Localization.Away (t P V)) (x P V m) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (t P V)) ∧ (∀ (V : S.affineOpens) (r : Γ(S, V.1)), a V (algebraMap Γ(S, V.1) (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.sections F (op V.1)) r) = algebraMap Γ(S, V.1) (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (P.algebra.grading V) (t P V)) r) ∧ (∀ (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1), Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.restriction F (homOfLE h).op)) ≫ chartMap P ht a V = chartMap P ht a U)
